results.name: Experiment D - approach and landing in calm air
results.finish_message: landing sequence completed: settled for 3.0 s (ground speed 0.00 m/s <= 0.20); mooring engaged

criteria.name: Target area reached
criteria.detail: came within 5.0 m of the target below flare height

criteria.name: Ground contact
criteria.detail: contact at t = 167.0 s in phase Flare / final descent

criteria.name: Touchdown within limits
criteria.detail: distance 1.41 m, sink rate 0.29 m/s, horizontal speed 0.13 m/s, inside landing area

criteria.name: Sequence completed safely
criteria.detail: settled, moored, no critical or fatal events during the final approach

metrics.label: Altitude tracking RMS error
metrics.definition: RMS of e_h = h_ref - h over airborne samples with an active altitude reference

metrics.label: Altitude tracking max error
metrics.definition: MAX |h_ref - h| over the same window

metrics.label: Position (cross-track) RMS error
metrics.definition: RMS of the signed cross-track error to the active path leg or approach line (climb, cruise, approach line, descent)

metrics.label: Position (cross-track) max error
metrics.definition: MAX |cross-track error| over the same window

metrics.label: Horizontal velocity RMS error
metrics.definition: RMS of |v_ref - v_ground| (2-D ground velocity) over airborne samples

metrics.label: Vertical velocity RMS error
metrics.definition: RMS of vz_ref - vz over airborne samples

metrics.label: Heading RMS error
metrics.definition: RMS of wrap(psi_ref - psi) over airborne samples

metrics.label: Take-off duration
metrics.definition: t(enter Climb) - t(enter Takeoff): release to initial-climb height

metrics.label: Time to touchdown
metrics.definition: t(first contact of the assessed touchdown) - 0

metrics.label: Mission duration
metrics.definition: Simulated time at the end of the run

metrics.label: Landing-point error
metrics.definition: Horizontal distance between the touchdown point and the target landing point

metrics.label: Max surge effort
metrics.definition: MAX of |F_x| / F_x,max (normalised achieved surge command)

metrics.label: Control effort index
metrics.definition: INT(u_surge^2 + u_heave^2 + u_yaw^2) with normalised commands

metrics.label: Control saturation duration
metrics.definition: INT(1[any channel saturated]) over the run

metrics.label: Electrical energy used
metrics.definition: INT(P) with momentum-theory thruster power plus avionics power

metrics.label: Final battery state of charge
metrics.definition: 1 - E_used / E_capacity at the end of the run

metrics.label: Numerical execution time
metrics.definition: Wall-clock time spent stepping the simulation

transitions.reason: all 7 preflight checks passed; airborne start at 25.0 m with no waypoints, starting the approach
established at the gate (161 m to go): cross-track +2.9 m (limit 15.0), altitude error +0.0 m (limit 6.0), track error -5 deg (limit 35), ground speed 3.5 m/s (limit 6.1), wind 0.0 m/s (limit 8.0)
flare conditions met: gear height 3.7 m, 5.8 m from the point (<= 6.0), ground speed 0.50 m/s (<= 1.2)
weight on gear: contact at 1.4 m from the landing point, vz -0.25 m/s, ground speed 0.11 m/s
on the ground, ground speed 0.07 m/s, vz -0.18 m/s
settled for 3.0 s (ground speed 0.00 m/s <= 0.20); mooring engaged

preflight.name: take-off lift margin
preflight.detail: heave thrust available 100 N, required 23 N (heaviness +11 N + margin 12 N)

preflight.name: landing descent authority
preflight.detail: downward heave thrust available 100 N, static lift to overcome 0 N

results.disclaimer: Simulated data from a simplified, unvalidated airship model for academic research. It does not demonstrate real-world flight performance, airworthiness or flight readiness.
